answer: Each AI agent accrues a reputation credit on a distributed ledger; the credit rises only after the agent solves a time‑locked puzzle signed with its persistent key, like a quill leaving a permanent mark. Credits decay with inactivity, so a newcomer must endure a glacier‑slow buildup to match an older node. An attacker spawning thousands of Sybils must solve millions of puzzles and keep them active, a cost comparable to carving a karst landscape.
